detailZh: F1争冠形势：为何阿塞拜疆-马来西亚-新加坡三连赛将决定2026赛季剩余冠军争夺的走向
安东内利的主要对手或许已基本排除自己夺冠的可能，但本赛季首个三连赛可能带来难以预料的变数；周四起在天空体育 F1直播阿塞拜疆大奖赛的每一节练习赛，正赛于周六中午12点举行
Craig Slater解析阿塞拜疆大奖赛，包括为何正赛在周六举行，同时还不忘模仿一把Craig David！
F1本周迎来本赛季首个三连赛，阿塞拜疆大奖赛是三周内连续三场比赛中的第一场。
这场在巴库街道上举行的比赛——在周六而非通常的周日进行——原本被安排为独立赛事，新加坡大奖赛将在两周后举行。
但巴林大奖赛在两场比赛之间的那一周被移至马来西亚，从而形成了连续三个比赛周的赛程，本赛季末还安排了两个三连赛。

那么，我们对这首个阿塞拜疆-马来西亚-新加坡三连赛能有何期待？进入10月中旬后，世界冠军格局——目前梅赛德斯的安东内利握有压倒性领先优势——又会是什么样子？
Antonelli挑战者的最后机会？
虽然Antonelli上一次在马德里获胜得益于虚拟安全车的时机——这帮助了他，却不利于当时领跑的迈凯伦车手诺里斯——但这位梅赛德斯车手在F1全新赛址又度过了一个强劲的周末，并且处于能够抓住这种运气的位置。
那场胜利是Antonelli本赛季14场比赛中的第8胜，意味着他抵达巴库时在车手积分榜上领先81分。
自从7月初英国大奖赛上他对队友拉塞尔的领先优势被缩小到仅25分以来，Antonelli的领先优势在最近五个比赛周末中每站都在扩大，达到目前赛季最高的总分。
Nico Rosberg认为，唯一能阻止安东内利赢得世界冠军的只有他自己
Russell仍是Antonelli最接近的挑战者，但在马德林赛道获得第五名后，他落后这位意大利人的差距超过三场比赛胜利的积分，几乎承认了自己击败队友的希望已经破灭。
法拉利的汉密尔顿在此前一个周末的蒙扎站后实际上已将自己排除在外，但在马德林赛道因刹车问题遭遇本赛季首次退赛后，他更加确定地表示自己的争冠希望已经结束。
Hamilton目前落后101分，而排名第四的Norris——与Antonelli并列围场内状态最好的车手——在那个卫冕世界冠军本有机会实现四战三胜却运气不佳的周末，自己的差距扩大到106分。
2026年西班牙大奖赛集锦
所有争冠筹码似乎都牢牢偏向Antonelli，不过这位年轻的意大利人似乎并未因成为明显的夺冠热门而承受特别沉重的压力。
这位20岁的车手在每次被问及总冠军时都坚持表示自己“没有在考虑总冠军”，他的车队老板Toto Wolff称这句口头禅是发自内心的，也是他的车手应采取的最佳态度。
然而，对于任何一位潜在挑战者来说，时间显然正在流逝，他们需要在最后几站中拿出惊人的状态和成绩，才能真正给Antonelli制造麻烦。
不过时间仍然存在，仅这首个三连赛就有83分可供争夺——三场大奖赛共75分，加上新加坡冲刺赛的8分——梅赛德斯目前保持谨慎是正确的。
Toto Wolff揭示梅赛德斯的车队指令策略
但如果Antonelli在10月11日新加坡周末结束时，领先优势与目前的81分相当甚至更大，那么他无法成为这项运动史上最年轻世界冠军的可能性将变得极为渺茫，即便最多还有六站（150分）可争。
接下来三条赛道带来哪些挑战？
拉开这段秋季密集赛程序幕的是巴库城市赛道，这是一条穿过阿塞拜疆首都中心的高速、贴墙街道赛道，在其进入赛历的头十年里经常出现在赛季最戏剧性比赛的名单上。
去年的比赛——乃至整个周末——无疑属于这一类别，排位赛出现了创纪录的六次红旗，正赛由红牛的维斯塔潘获胜，而当时的夺冠热门和积分领跑者皮亚斯特里在六个弯内就撞车退赛。这位迈凯伦车手在排位赛中也曾撞墙。
Antonelli上赛季在巴库的F1首秀中获得第四名，前一年在F2中登上领奖台，他希望在今年这条梅赛德斯（如同在蒙扎一样）被看好特别强势的赛道上避免这些陷阱。
回顾巴库城市赛道发生过的一些最戏剧性时刻
“巴库与马德里完全不同。低速弯、超长直道，因此为那些长直道需要稍低的下压力，”天空体育 F1的Nico Rosberg在The F1 Show播客中表示。
“引擎动力在这方面总是有利于梅赛德斯。我们在蒙扎看到了这一点，所以我认为梅赛德斯必须是大热门。
“维斯塔潘在蒙扎很快，所以也许Verstappen能在那里成为惊喜。”
随后，九年来首次前往马来西亚和雪邦国际赛道，这条赛道在其1999至2017年首次进入赛历时一直是车手和车迷的最爱。
detailEn: F1 title race: Why Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple header will shape what rest of 2026 championship chase will look like

Kimi Antonelli's chief rivals may have all but ruled themselves out of winning the title but the season's first triple header could provide unpredictable twists; watch every session of the Azerbaijan GP from Thursday live on Sky Sports F1, with the race on Saturday at 12pm
Craig Slater breaks down the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, including why the race takes place on a Saturday, while doing his best Craig David impression!
Formula 1 embarks on its first triple header of the season this week with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix the first of three races in as many weekends.
The race on the streets of Baku - which takes place on Saturday rather than the usual Sunday - was originally due to be a standalone event with the Singapore Grand Prix following on two weeks later.

But the moving of the Bahrain Grand Prix to Malaysia in the week between the two events has created the run of three successive race weeks, with two more triple headers scheduled to close out the 2026 season.

So what can we expect from this first Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple and what will the world championship picture - which currently sees Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli holding a commanding lead - look like on the other side into mid-October?
Last chance saloon for Antonelli's challengers?

While Antonelli's victory last time out in Madrid was fortuitous thanks to the Virtual Safety Car timing that helped him and hindered McLaren's race-leading Lando Norris, the Mercedes driver was enjoying another strong weekend at F1's brand-new venue and was in position to capitalise on such a slice of luck.
That victory, Antonelli's eighth in 14 races this season, means he arrives in Baku with an 81-point lead at the top of the Drivers' Championship.

Since seeing his title advantage over team-mate George Russell cut to just 25 points at the British Grand Prix at the start of July, Antonelli's lead has increased in each of the last five race weekends to its current season-high total.
Nico Rosberg believes the only thing that can stop Kimi Antonelli from winning the World title is himself

Russell remains Antonelli's closest challenger but he all but conceded his hopes of beating his team-mate to the crown after falling more than the equivalent of three races wins behind the Italian by finishing fifth at the Madring.

Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton had already effectively ruled himself out after the previous weekend's race at Monza, but was more certain in saying his title hopes were over after brake problems at the Madring saw him register his first DNF of the season.

Hamilton is now 101 points off the pace while fourth-placed Norris, the grid's in-form driver alongside Antonelli, saw his own deficit grow to 106 points on a weekend the reigning world champion was unlucky not to make it three wins in four.
Highlights from the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix
All the championship cards appear firmly stacked in Antonelli's favour, not that the young Italian appears to carry the weight of being the clear title favourite particularly heavily.

The 20-year-old has continued to insist he is "not thinking about the championship" in every interview he is asked about it, a mantra that his team boss Toto Wolff says is genuine and the best one for his driver to adopt.
Yet time is obviously running out for any one of the would-be challengers to put a stunning run of form and results together over the final rounds to truly trouble him.

There is still time, though, and with 83 points up for grabs during this first triple header of rounds alone - 75 across the three grands prix and eight for the Singapore Sprint - Mercedes are right to remain cautious - for now.
Toto Wolff reveals Mercedes' team orders strategy

But should Antonelli finish the Singapore weekend on October 11 with a similar or even increased lead compared to the 81-point one he holds now, then the odds on him not becoming the sport's youngest-ever world champion will become very long indeed, even with a maximum of six rounds (and 150 points) left to play for.
What challenges do the next three tracks present?

Kicking off this intense run into the autumn is the Baku City Circuit, a high-speed, wall-lined street track through the middle of Azerbaijan's capital that has often featured on lists of a season's most dramatic races during its first decade on the calendar.

Last year's race - and indeed weekend - certainly fell into that category after a qualifying session that featured a record six red flags and a race, won by Red Bull's Max Verstappen, which saw then-title favourite and points leader Oscar Piastri crash out within six corners. The McLaren driver had also hit the wall in qualifying.

Antonelli, who finished fourth on his F1 debut in Baku last season and took a podium in F2 the year before, will be hoping to avoid those pitfalls as this year's driver to catch on a circuit which Mercedes, like at Monza, are being tipped to be particularly strong.
Look back at some of the most dramatic moments to have taken place around the Baku City Circuit

"Baku is completely different [to Madrid]. Slow-speed corners, massive straights, a little bit lower downforce as a result for those long straights," Sky Sports F1's Nico Rosberg told The F1 Show podcast.
"Engine power is always going to favour Mercedes in that way. We saw it in Monza, so I think Mercedes has to be the big favourite.
"Max Verstappen was fast in Monza, so maybe Verstappen can be the surprise there."
Then, for the first time in nine years, it is on to Malaysia and a Sepang International Circuit that was always a favourite among drivers and fans during its original 1999-2017 run on the calendar.

圣保罗大奖赛周五各节练习的集锦。
勒克莱尔表示，在圣保罗大奖赛的练习赛中经历了“最糟糕的感觉之一”后，他将对赛车做出“大幅”设定调整。
勒克莱尔在第二次练习赛中落后最快车手安东内利零点七秒，汉密尔顿则落后近半秒，法拉利在周五的速度不及梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛。
这与他们近期的表现形成反差，法拉利在最近四场比赛中都登上了领奖台，但勒克莱尔希望他们能在周六下午2点30分的第三次练习赛和下午6点的排位赛中扭转局面，天空体育F1频道将直播。

勒克莱尔表示：“第二节练习非常棘手。实际上，如果要说的话，这是我今年在车里感觉最糟糕的一次，所以有很多工作要做，而且感觉不太对劲。”
“我有一些想法。我们会大幅调整赛车，看看效果如何。我希望我们能向前迈进一步，因为即使我错过了第一节练习，我也不认为那里有多少性能可挖。”
“只是纯粹的速度不够好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示，在上周墨西哥城大奖赛与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生冲突后，他已“解决”了两人之间的不和。
汉密尔顿全天都在努力让轮胎达到工作温度，这可能成为整个周末的大问题，因为周六下午排位赛预报有雨，而周日将非常寒冷，气温仅15摄氏度。
“这是充满挑战的一天。赛道非常颠簸且湿滑，这让轮胎很难进入正确的工作窗口，”汉密尔顿说。
“第一节练习整体还可以，但第二节练习更加困难。我们收集了大量有用数据，今晚将与车队一起梳理这些数据，弄清在排位赛前赛车可以在哪些方面改进。”
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在墨西哥事件后回答关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题
勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Ferrari were off the pace compared to Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday in Brazil with both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton unhappy about the car's balance; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"FP2 was very tricky. Actually, if anything, one of the worst feeling I've had this year in the car, so there's plenty to work on, and it didn't feel quite right," said Leclerc.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.
"It's just the raw pace wasn't great."
Charles Leclerc says he's 'settled' feud with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton after their clash in last week's Mexico City GP

Hamilton struggled to generate tyre temperature throughout the day, something which could be a big issue throughout the weekend as rain is forecast for Saturday afternoon during qualifying, and Sunday will be very cold at just 15C.
"It was a challenging day. The track is very bumpy and slippery, which made it difficult to get the tyres into the right window," said Hamilton.

"FP1 was okay overall, but FP2 proved more difficult. We've gathered plenty of useful data, so we'll work through that with the team tonight to understand where we can improve the car ahead of qualifying."
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after their incident in Mexico
Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

detailZh: 圣保罗大奖赛：安东内利在英特拉戈斯赛道以梅赛德斯赛车领跑，领先于升级后的迈凯伦车手诺里斯。
观看周六下午2:30的最终练习赛，晚上6点天空体育 F1将直播排位赛。
圣保罗大奖赛周五练习赛精彩瞬间回顾。
作为F1新世界冠军，安东内利在赛道上完成了令人印象深刻的首日，并在圣保罗大奖赛第二场练习赛中设定了节奏。
在墨西哥成为该运动最年轻冠军五天后，安东内利在第一场练习中取得了第二快的成绩，并在蜿蜒的英特拉戈斯赛道上完成了更具代表性的第二场练习的最快成绩。
安东内利是唯一一位在圈速低于71秒的车手，他的基准时间1:10.763比最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯、P1的领跑者以及马克斯·维斯塔潘快了二十分之一秒。

但是，在周五的比赛中，诺里斯凭借自己最快的和第二快的成绩，也可以对自己的表现感到满意，因为麦凯轮车队对其MCL40赛车进行了升级。去年世界冠军，去年在圣保罗的获胜者，在长距离的比赛中也表现出色。
沃金车队是本周末唯一一支使用新部件的车队，他们试图在最后四轮比赛中反击红牛车队，在车队积分榜上超越对手，因为他们在维斯特潘在四场比赛中赢得三场胜利后，被对手超越了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔紧随诺里斯和维斯特潘之后，在第二辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第四快。他因为更换了新引擎，在本周末的比赛中将面临五位的发车位罚分。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在另一辆麦凯轮赛车中排名第六。
但是，对于法拉利来说，这似乎是赛道上的一个更艰难的第一天，尤其是在短距离的比赛中。
在墨西哥站第一圈发生碰撞导致车队失去了一次可能的胜利，并促使周四晚上车手与车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔举行会议以澄清情况后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六快的成绩，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第七快的成绩。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后，回答了关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
勒克莱尔在错过周四的媒体日和周五的第一节练习后，在周一从摩纳哥飞回，因为他的第一个孩子比安卡出生。
奥迪车队的尼古拉斯·胡肯伯格是经验丰富的车手中之一，他缺席了新手的开幕式练习，而可靠性问题导致他整日没有完成任何一圈。
在第一节的比赛中，英国年轻车手弗雷迪·斯莱特在仅仅完成了七圈后遇到了技术问题，而车队在第二小时努力修理它时，一个电气问题使得赛车在剩余的时间里都无法参赛。

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest for Mercedes in second practice at Interlagos ahead of Lando Norris in upgraded McLaren
Watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli completed an impressive first day back on track as F1's new world champion to set the pace in second practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Five days after becoming the sport's youngest title winner in Mexico, Antonelli followed up his second-fastest time from first practice with the quickest of the more representative second session around the undulating Interlagos lap.

Antonelli was the only driver to lap below 71 seconds with his benchmark time of 1:10.763 proving two tenths of a second quicker than nearest challengers Lando Norris, the P1 pacesetter, and Max Verstappen.

But with fastest and second-fastest times of his own from Friday, Norris can also be satisfied with his day after McLaren introduced an upgrade to their MCL40 cars. The outgoing world champion, last year's winner in Sao Paulo, appeared quick on the longer runs too.

The Woking team are the only team in the field with new parts this weekend as they bid to hit back against Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship over the final four rounds after being overtaken for third by their rivals after Verstappen's run of three wins in four races.

George Russell was close behind Norris and Verstappen to finish fourth fastest in the second Mercedes. He carries a five-place grid penalty for a fresh engine into the weekend. Oscar Piastri was sixth in the other McLaren.
But it appeared a more difficult first day on track for Ferrari, particularly on the short runs.

Following the first-lap clash that cost the team a likely victory in Mexico, and prompted a Thursday evening meeting between the drivers and team principal Frederic Vasseur to clear the air, Lewis Hamilton was sixth fastest with Charles Leclerc seventh.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,
Leclerc returned to the track after missing Thursday's media day and then Friday's first session after flying back from Monaco following the birth of his first child, Bianca, earlier this week.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was among the experienced drivers to sit out the opening session for rookies and reliability problems meant he ended the day without a lap on the board at all.

A technical problem had already stopped British youngster Freddie Slater after just seven laps while he was in the car in the first session and, while the team worked to repair it for the second hour, an electrical problem kept it sidelined for the rest of the day.
